collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — RELATIONSHIPS, SINGLEHOOD AND FAMILY (FAM2-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Couples of every kind, courting, quarrels, separations without blame, widowhood and second loves, happily single and childfree villagers, single parents, grandparents, siblings, chosen and extended families, and affection that isn't romantic. Nobody has to love, marry or have children, everyone may say no to affection, and a player's choice never obliges a villager to anything.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult and a child aged 4-10)

collection.description: A little child leaps at their favorite grown-up, who has a sore back and a basket of eggs: ask for a high five, or brace.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (friend) has a new favorite grown-up: (subject). Every time (friend.he/she) sees (subject), (friend.he/she) runs at (subject.him/her) full speed and leaps into (subject.his/her) arms. (subject) is fond of (friend), but (subject.his/her) back is sore today, and (subject.he/she) has a basket of eggs, and (friend) is already running.

choices.label: Ask for a High Five Instead
Put the Eggs Down and Brace

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "Wait!" says (subject), holding up the basket. "Eggs! Can we do a high five today instead?" (friend) skids to a stop, considers, and gives (subject.him/her) a high five so hard it stings. "Tomorrow, a hug?" (friend.he/she) asks. "If my back's better," says (subject). It isn't, quite. They invent a special handshake instead. It has eleven steps.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (subject) puts the eggs down very fast and catches (friend), who is heavier than (friend.he/she) looks. (subject.His/her) back complains loudly. "Oof," says (subject). "You're getting big." (friend) is delighted by this. Later, (subject) gently explains that sometimes grown-ups need a gentler hello. (friend) nods seriously, and next time walks up and gives (subject.him/her) a very careful hug around the knees.
